% Starred and mixed lines: axis x line=middle with axis y line=right, and starred lines keep enlargement and inside ticks.
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[name=a, axis x line=middle, axis y line=right, xlabel={X}, ylabel={Y}, width=180pt, height=150pt]
  \addplot coordinates {(-2,-1) (0,1) (3,2.5)};
\end{axis}
\begin{axis}[at={(a.outer south east)}, anchor=outer south west, xshift=10pt, axis lines*=left, width=180pt, height=150pt]
  \addplot coordinates {(-2,-1) (0,1) (3,2.5)};
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
